name: crypto_price
description: Get current cryptocurrency price in USD from CoinGecko API. Supports 50+ coins: bitcoin, ethereum, solana, xrp, cardano, dogecoin, polygon, avalanche, chainlink, litecoin, bnb, uniswap, cosmos, near, arbitrum, optimism, toncoin, pepe, shiba inu, and many more. Accepts common names (solana), symbols (SOL, ETH, BTC), or CoinGecko IDs. Use this when the user asks about crypto prices.

coin.description: Cryptocurrency name, symbol, or CoinGecko ID. Examples: bitcoin, btc, ethereum, eth, solana, sol, xrp, cardano, ada, dogecoin, doge, polygon, matic, avalanche, avax, chainlink, link, arbitrum, optimism, toncoin, ton, pepe, shiba, bonk
